messages:
maya: Heads up — noticed a pattern where the invoice preview shows ~0 tokens for whole tenant groups after the hourly aggregation. Looks like 'ack ledger' is sparse. Anyone seen this?
jonathan: saw a blip earlier, assumed lag. Any evidence it's permanent or just a late commit window?
li: I pulled commit logs: several consumer groups lagging ~30-90s and then commit batches skip some offsets. snippet: ```kafka.consumer-lag: consumer=ingest-joiner,lag=42,commit_errors=0,committed_offsets=[..]```
rachel: dashboard shows the preview card (hourly) drop to 0 for 5 tenants at 14:03 UTC, then recovers — but invoices still missing tokens.
samir: my hunch: if commit acks arrive after the aggregator snapshot window we mark them as 'unsettled' and they fall into 'sparsity' bucket which is ignored by preview.
arjun: that matches an earlier bug we saw; aggregator snapshot uses watermark=-1 if commit_ts>window_end. We intentionally discard those to avoid double-count. maybe too aggressive.
maya: can we confirm if these 'late commits' are being written to tally ledger at all? I can run a query.
ingest-bot: ingest-audit: wrote 127 events for tenant=acme-corp, last_commit_ts=1700000005, consumer_group=ingest-joiner
li: query shows the ledger has entries but with flag=postwindow. Export sample: ```select count(*) from tally where flag='postwindow' and tenant in ('acme-corp','beta-inc');``` => 312
jonathan: ok so they're in ledger but preview pipeline explicitly filters flag!='postwindow'. That's the washout.
rachel: how does that affect final invoices? Our billing pipeline downstream consumes ledger and applies de-dupe windows; are postwindow entries applied or dropped?
samir: downstream settles them only if a reconciliation pass picks them up. Currently reconciliation runs daily; immediate previews won't include them.
arjun: proposal: include postwindow entries in hourly preview but mark them as 'late-ack' with tooltip. That will avoid surprise zeros.
maya: 👍 we should also track histogram of postwindow latency per tenant. Add a telemetry metric: meter.postwindow_secs{tenant} gauge/histogram.
li: I'll open a small PR to change preview filter + add metric. Will add an opt-in canary flag tenant-level to avoid noise.
jonathan: also add an alert if postwindow rate > 0.1% of tokens for a tenant over 1h.
rachel: UX: preview card should show 'estimated' when late acks included and a note linking to rollouts console.
samir: FYI this will slightly change preview-to-invoice delta; finance ok with this if we label it and keep reconciliation.
arjun: sounds good. li — assign me as reviewer.
li: will do. PR coming in ~30m.
maya: thanks all. I'll run a one-off reconciliation for the affected tenants after PR deploy to see diff.
ingest-bot: deploy-bot: canary preview feature flag enabled for tenant=acme-corp by li at 2024-05-10T14:45:00Z
jonathan: great, watch the dashboard for washout to shrink. ping if anything weird :eyes:
